title: Jungle Cenote Temple
summary: An interactive Three.js HD-2D pixel-art diorama rendered at 480×270 with ordered Bayer dithering, waterfalls, a mana crystal, and a macaw.
description: An interactive Three.js HD-2D pixel-art jungle diorama and 30-second scored short rendered natively at 480×270 with configurable Bayer dithering. Four carved spouts feed a stepped jade pool beneath a limestone sanctuary housing a rotating mana crystal and a perched scarlet macaw.
